name: jev-router
description: Asks TypeSafe Jev on each new prompt which local skills fit and which Claude model and effort to use

typesafe_api_key.title: General · TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Key for api.typesafe.ai. Stored in secure storage. The router stays off while it is empty.

enabled.title: General · Router enabled
enabled.description:
Turn the Jev skill router on or off without uninstalling it.
Default: on

write_log.title: General · Write log
write_log.description:
Record each round and step to the plugin data folder. Prompt text and keys are never written.
Default: off

reset_to_defaults.title: General · Reset all settings to defaults
reset_to_defaults.description:
Turn on to restore every setting below. The API key is kept. The switch turns itself off.
Default: off

mode.title: Skill · Load mode
mode.description:
hint: suggest the skill so Claude loads it with the Skill tool. inject: add its SKILL.md text directly (not a native activation).
Default: hint

gate_threshold.title: Skill · Gate threshold
gate_threshold.description:
Below this mean gate score, no skill is suggested. The Skill Suggestion cookbook value.
Default: 0.3

fits_threshold.title: Skill · Fits threshold
fits_threshold.description:
Every shortlisted skill whose fit reaches this is suggested, with no count limit. The Skill Suggestion cookbook value.
Default: 0.3

model_routing.title: Model · Model routing
model_routing.description:
off: never change the model. dry-run: log what Jev would send, change nothing. on: send each main request with Jev's choice when it is confident.
Default: dry-run

model_threshold.title: Model · Model confidence threshold
model_threshold.description:
Jev's model choice is used only when its confidence reaches this. TypeSafe Confidence guide example floor.
Default: 0.5

fallback_model.title: Model · Fallback model
fallback_model.description:
Used when Jev is not confident or fails. session: the model you chose with /model. The chat panel's model display never changes.
Default: session

effort_threshold.title: Effort · Effort confidence threshold
effort_threshold.description:
Jev's effort choice is used only when its confidence reaches this. Lower than the model threshold because effort confidence runs lower.
Default: 0.4
